analysis:
Examined docs/reference/configuration.md head lines 1–484 and the supplied change map/patch. Within these numbered excerpts only the update date (line 3) changes. Surrounding documentation retains bounded model/context admission, fail-closed native retirement, encrypted prefix caching, owner-only lifecycle state, logout issuer binding, default-off attestation qualification and explicit cache-location selection. No security regression is supported by those unchanged descriptions; implementation correctness is not established by documentation.
The patch at head lines 923–936 introduces a security-relevant integration contract: signed releases can register cluster_runtime via POST /v1/releases, from which the coordinator derives cluster approvals, pair-serving grants and parity qualifications. Integration must examine the remaining changed documentation and release-generation/registration source to establish who controls those facts, how grants and parity qualifications are authorized, and whether release publication remains separate from independently approved serving qualification (A-005, A-011, A-017, T-054, TB-011). This excerpt alone does not establish an authorization bypass or justify a finding. The truncated patch and absent implementation leave that PR-specific question unresolved. Cache scoping and encryption described here remain consistent with the supplied T-041 definition; no changed cache control is visible in this scope.
